content: Ollama is a self-hosted language model platform that allows users to process their personal monthly credit card statements locally on their machine without relying on external services like AWS. It also provides an agent task functionality similar to GitHub Copilot for JetBrains. Ollama supports different apps and harnesses, making it suitable for various productivity tasks including image editing, text generation, and more.

Ollama is a language model platform that processes personal monthly credit card statements locally on the user's machine using their device's hardware. It allows users to engage in a variety of productive tasks without relying on external services such as AWS or GitHub Copilot for JetBrains.
